display_long_description:
Educational software for years 4 to 10 & STEM. Designed for full class rotational use with virtual tutor direct instructions. 

VR Drone Flight Simulator is an immersive educational experience that lets students safely explore the world of drones while building real-world STEM skills. Students can pilot drones in a virtual environment, mastering controls, physics, and experimenting by swapping components or cargo to see how changes affect flight.

The app features time trials and challenge missions to develop precision, problem-solving, and spatial reasoning. Students receive virtual tutor direct instruction on drones in the real world, including how UAVs are used in industry, research, and logistics, giving context to their virtual training.

A personal tutor answers student questions and provides differentiated questioning to match each learner’s level, helping them progress at their own pace. Educators can choose to use passthrough or email-based student data collection to track progress, performance, and engagement over time, making it ideal for classrooms, VR labs, and remote learning environments.

Perfect for STEM learning, this simulator develops digital literacy, engineering thinking, and confidence in drone flight. Students experience hands-on, curriculum-aligned lessons that prepare them for real-world UAV applications, all in a safe, interactive, and engaging virtual space.
